steps.title: Top bar
steps.say: [tsundere] That's the shared top bar. Every Afterlife High site has one, so you can't get lost. Probably.
steps.say_plain: This is the shared top bar. It links every Afterlife High site.

steps.title: Main content
steps.say: [happy] This is the main area. Everything you came for lives here.
steps.say_plain: This is the main content area.

steps.title: Navigation
steps.say: [neutral] Use the navigation to hop between the hub, CRM, TCG, deckbox and wiki.
steps.say_plain: Use the navigation to move between the hub, CRM, TCG, deckbox and wiki.

steps.title: The hub
steps.say: [tsundere] Hub first. It has the map. Try not to get lost before the first turn.
steps.say_plain: Start at the hub. It has the map of every project.

steps.title: The CRM
steps.say: [embarrassed] The CRM is for contacts, companies, deals and activity. Plain and useful. You're welcome.
steps.say_plain: The CRM manages contacts, companies, deals and activity.

steps.title: Deckbox
steps.say: [happy] Deckbox has downloads and setup notes. Verify the package before you run it, okay?
steps.say_plain: Deckbox has downloads and setup notes. Verify packages before running them.

steps.title: Ask me
steps.say: [neutral] And if you're still lost, ask me. Type it, or hold the talk button.
steps.say_plain: If you need more help, ask me by typing or using the talk button.
